scope: Generation configuration, prompt construction, paired stage inference, and the existing CHAT export boundary. Annotation, features, analyses, results, and classifiers are outside this audit.

runtime_flow.purpose: Select TD/SLI children in an age bin and solve one-to-one minimum-total-age-gap pairing.
runtime_flow.condition: Package builders only build a roster when the cohort roster file does not already exist.
runtime_flow.caution: The table is consumed for child metadata; no severity/profile table is required. Do not overwrite frozen historical pairings.

runtime_flow.input: configs/generation/*frozen_roster.csv and the age-specific rosters inside colab_generation_package_direct_rotating_multi_age
runtime_flow.purpose: Build rounds, schedules, bundle indexes, feature placeholders, and split bookkeeping.
runtime_flow.caution: This baseline called only the in-memory schedule/round/split functions. It did not call a package-writing builder. The four-year-old saved generations differ from the current frozen roster in two pairs.

runtime_flow.purpose: Choose opposite-set TD and SLI exemplar story slots. Variant selection uses pair order and replicate number.
runtime_flow.caution: One schedule row is a target-story job with two stages; a six-story bundle groups one pair and replicate.

runtime_flow.purpose: Load the project-authored picture-derived story spine, title, invariants, optional details, and constraints.
runtime_flow.caution: This is the actual runtime scaffold. Official picture PDFs and story-packet drafts support its provenance but are not loaded during text generation.

runtime_flow.purpose: Look up exemplar text by child ID, literal corpus group, and story slot.
runtime_flow.caution: The notebook substitutes an empty string for a missing key. The audited configured exemplar keys are currently present and nonempty.

runtime_flow.input: Enriched generation schedule and current notebook settings
runtime_flow.purpose: Load the tokenizer/model; construct Stage 1 messages; generate TD-like text; insert that text into Stage 2 messages; generate SLI-conditioned text; save the two outputs in the same CSV row.
runtime_flow.caution: The word 'direct' in the notebook name means native transformers execution. The implemented generation remains two-stage. Model loading and inference were not executed by this audit.

runtime_flow.input: Paired-stage generation CSV and matching cohort roster
runtime_flow.purpose: Export one CHAT transcript for each stage of each target-story job, with a chat_manifest.csv.
runtime_flow.caution: Historical source/output paths in existing CHAT comments and manifests can be stale. Existing transcripts were only read and hashed.
